Once you have achieved your goal, write "> done" to end the game.

The goal requires making the "hetle anird," "ioness opige," and "rotont reforian." I noticed the "ioness" is already present in the atival, so I should attempt to interact with it directly using the allowed special actions (onser, mellum, clogery, ellous, ially, upbes) rather than generic commands. I will try "onser" on the ioness first to see if it transforms it into "opige," then proceed to interact with the rotont and the other items using these specific verbs.
